title: Holder note and gate on a large item take ~14 s and show ~4.5 s on the live store
outcome: Holder note and gate on a large item take ~14 s and show ~4.5 s on the live store
acceptance: on the live Engram store's root item (274 notes, 26k work records) a holder note, a gate record, and show each complete well under one second; the mutation path is profiled and the O(n) step (canonical event or evidence loading per mutation, catalog refresh, or projection verification) is bounded by an index or a cut, with a scale-gate decode budget pinning it; no verification weakened

completion.summary: Readiness now uses indexed current bindings instead of replaying proofs for every hint; completion and doctor retain exhaustive proof checks. Counter regressions, exact refusal and rollback tests, nine gates and paired closure accepted. Coordinator reports installed live-root show 140 ms, next 172 ms and note 350 ms.
